blocks.hero.eyebrow: Porn addiction counseling · Online across Kentucky or in Louisville
blocks.hero.subhead: You've tried to stop, and it keeps pulling you back. That doesn't mean you're broken. Confidential counseling for men that gets underneath the habit, without shame, toward a real peace porn can't give.

facts.text: Online from home, anywhere in Kentucky

blocks.request.heading: There's a way out, and you don't have to find it alone
blocks.request.text: Request an appointment in about a minute, or call (502) 523-2970. Most people are seen the same week.
blocks.request.crisis: If you're thinking about suicide or are in crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline), or call 911.

signs.items.text: You've promised yourself you'd stop, more times than you can count.
It's the first thing you reach for when you're stressed, bored, or lonely.
You feel a wave of shame afterward, and then do it again.
It's going against what you believe, and that's eating at you.
You're hiding it from your wife or the people closest to you.
Filters and accountability apps helped for a while, then didn't.

blocks.faith.heading: Faith at the center, never forced
blocks.faith.body:
For Christian men, recovery isn't just about stopping. It's about drawing closer to God instead of hiding from Him. Your counselor will bring faith into the work in the ways that help you, never as a lecture.

If you'd rather leave faith out, your counselor's care is just as thorough, and they follow your lead. [How faith works at Freedom](/christian-counseling)

sections.heading: Why it's so hard to stop
sections.body:
Men are made for peace, but life often creates chaos. Over time, the hard parts of life pile up: feeling inadequate, feeling like you don't measure up at work or at home, feeling powerless to change things. Those experiences create real emotional needs, and many men don't know how to recognize them, much less what to do with them. They just feel like restlessness, stress, or something churning inside.

Because you're made for peace, your body fights back against that chaos. It reaches for whatever will bring relief fastest, and pornography delivers a rush of dopamine that eases the pain and soothes the need for a moment. But it's a false peace. The need is still there afterward, often with shame on top of it, and the cycle starts again. That's why willpower alone so rarely works.

sections.heading: The way out is intimacy, not just willpower
sections.body:
The real answer to the need underneath is intimacy: with God, with yourself, and with the people in your life. It's the only way out of the addictive cycle.

In counseling, you'll learn to understand your own cycle of porn addiction and why it's been so hard to break. Then you'll learn, step by step, to recognize what you're actually feeling and needing, and to meet those needs through real connection with God, yourself, and others. Along the way you'll build a healthier emotional life overall, on a path that leads to real peace instead of the false peace pornography offers.

sections.heading: Working against shame, not with it
sections.body: Shame keeps the cycle going, so we actively work against it. The part of you that turns to porn is actually trying to do something good: to bring you relief and peace. It's been hijacked and turned against your own morals and values. Acting against what you believe can leave a real wound, sometimes called moral injury, and that wound deserves care, not more condemnation. Understanding this is often where change begins.

sections.heading: Confidential, and close to home
sections.body: What you share stays between you and your counselor, within the limits the law sets (like safety), which he'll explain at the start. You can meet online from home, anywhere in Kentucky, or at our Middletown office in Louisville.

sections.heading: If you're his wife
sections.body: Finding out about a husband's porn addiction can be devastating, and you deserve support of your own. Tony Gore, LCSW, works with wives directly, and with couples who want help for their marriage because of it.

blocks.team.heading: Who you'll work with

team.items.text: Men working to break free of porn addiction, with a faith-integrated, shame-free approach.
Wives affected by a husband's porn addiction, and couples who want help for their marriage because of it.

blocks.expect.heading: Your first session
blocks.expect.body: You don't have to tell your whole story at once. Your first session is a conversation about what's been happening, what you've tried, and what you want to be different.
blocks.cost.body: We don't bill insurance, but you can pay with an HSA or FSA card, and we'll give you a superbill to submit for possible out-of-network reimbursement.
